title: Hiring outlook (ManpowerGroup)
description: ManpowerGroup's net employment outlook for Q4 2026 (survey 1 to 31 July 2026, press release 8 Sep 2026): share of employers planning to add staff minus share planning to cut, seasonally adjusted. IT and tech's previous value is ManpowerGroup's Q3 2026 figure from 9 Jun 2026; Västra Götaland's follows from the stated 2-point fall. Regions cover all industries.
